summary: Regression check on login/register for all three roles (admin/doctor/patient) after login-page error-message improvements. Backend endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/register) return 200 with { token, user } for all roles; wrong password returns 401 with 'Invalid credentials'. Frontend UI: admin/patient/doctor login through /login redirect correctly to /admin, /patient, /doctor respectively and their dashboards render (stat cards, risk panels, patient roster). UI /register for both patient and doctor auto-signs-in and lands on the correct dashboard. Wrong password stays on /login (no redirect). No blockers found.
passed: UI: admin login via /login -> /admin dashboard loads (14 users, 9 patients, 4 doctors visible)
UI: patient login via /login -> /patient dashboard loads (RiskPanel, aggregate score 2.2, HbA1c etc)
UI: doctor login via /login -> /doctor dashboard loads (patient roster + Invite patient button)
UI: wrong password on /login stays on /login (no redirect)
UI: /register (patient role selected) auto-signs-in and redirects to /patient; toast 'Account created — welcome, ...'
UI: /register (doctor role selected) auto-signs-in and redirects to /doctor
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is present in frontend/.env and API calls resolve to hosted backend (no api.js console.error triggered)
action_items: None for auth flow. Optional cleanup: Recharts prints repeated 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on patient/admin dashboards — cosmetic console noise, not a blocker.
notes: Backend /api/auth/register requires field 'full_name' (not 'name'); the frontend register form already sends the correct field, so UI flow works. If any future client sends 'name', the API responds 422. Not a bug for this iteration since Login.jsx / Register.jsx use the correct schema.
